title: The Story of Yunus
children_explanation_summary: Yunus was one of the messengers. He went to a laden ship, lots were drawn and he was among the losers, a fish swallowed him, and had he not been one who glorifies Allah he would have remained in it until the Day of Resurrection. In the darknesses he called out with the words of 21:87. Allah answered him and saved him from distress, cast him onto an open shore while he was ill, made a gourd vine grow over him, and sent him to a hundred thousand or more, who believed.

stated_in_quran.detail: He ran away to the laden ship.
He drew lots and was among the losers.
The fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy.
Had he not been of those who exalt Allah, he would have remained inside its belly until the Day of Resurrection.
He went off in anger and thought that Allah would not decree anything upon him.
He called out within the darknesses with the words of the supplication.
Allah responded to him and saved him from the distress, and thus saves the believers.
He was thrown onto the open shore while he was ill.
A gourd vine was caused to grow over him.
He was sent to a hundred thousand or more, who believed and were given enjoyment for a time.

not_specified_or_inferred.detail: Why he left and what made him angry.
not_specified_or_inferred.how_the_app_handles_it: Not explained. Commentaries discuss it; this needs scholar review before any explanation is added.

not_specified_or_inferred.detail: The ship's appearance, size, crew and passengers.
not_specified_or_inferred.how_the_app_handles_it: Painted small and far away, with no people; labeled as an artist's idea.
A calm sea is painted and the hotspot says the Quran does not describe the weather.
Only the fact of drawing lots (37:141) is mentioned.

not_specified_or_inferred.detail: The species, size and colour of the fish.
not_specified_or_inferred.how_the_app_handles_it: Shown as a soft dark shape; the hotspot says the Quran does not specify.

not_specified_or_inferred.detail: How long he stayed inside the fish.

not_specified_or_inferred.how_the_app_handles_it: The app only points out that the word is plural. Explanations from tafsir need a cited source and review first.

not_specified_or_inferred.detail: The location of the shore and the name of his people's town.
not_specified_or_inferred.how_the_app_handles_it: Not named. Traditions that name a town are not used.
Yunus is never depicted, in any form.

supplementary_sources.supporting_claim: Time of day, sky, weather and sea state are artistic choices; the hotspot text says that the Quran does not describe them.
Quoted English phrases in explanations ('the laden ship', 'gourd vine', 'within the darknesses', 'the open shore') are taken from this translation.
